core_principles: Progressive disclosure: Show top priority metric first, reveal details on tap.
Mobile-optimized B2B: Thumb-friendly tap targets (min 44px), always-visible bottom nav.
Data-dense but breathable: Flat cards, 1px borders, no heavy shadows.
Role-aware: Built for gym owners to track revenue and expiry, not for members.

headings.usage: H1 to H4, numbers on metric cards.

global.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#F9FAFB] pb-24 relative shadow-2xl overflow-x-hidden

bottom_navigation.container: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 max-w-md mx-auto h-16 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-gray-200 flex justify-around items-center z-50
bottom_navigation.item: flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-full space-y-1 text-gray-400

button.primary: w-full h-12 bg-black text-white rounded-xl font-semibold flex items-center justify-center active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform
button.secondary: w-full h-12 bg-gray-100 text-black rounded-xl font-semibold flex items-center justify-center active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform
button.danger: w-full h-12 bg-red-50 text-red-600 rounded-xl font-semibold flex items-center justify-center active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform

input.base: w-full h-12 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-xl px-4 text-base focus:border-black focus:ring-1 focus:ring-black outline-none transition-all

bottom_sheet.container: fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 max-w-md mx-auto bg-white rounded-t-3xl shadow-[0_-8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)] z-50 p-6 transform transition-transform

chart.guideline: Use Recharts. Hide grid lines. Use single solid color line (e.g. #2563EB) with subtle area gradient.

screens.auth: Clean minimal login. 'GymFlow' text logo in Cabinet Grotesk. Simple inputs, large black button.
screens.onboarding: 4-step wizard using a progress bar. Each step asks one thing clearly (Gym Name -> First Plan -> First Member -> WhatsApp Connect).
screens.dashboard: Top: Welcome + quick actions row (circular buttons: Add Member, New Plan, Send Blast). Middle: 2x3 grid for the 6 metric cards. Bottom: Revenue/Expiry trend chart.
screens.members: Search bar sticky at top. Filter pills (Active, Expiring, Expired) horizontally scrollable. Member list items showing Avatar, Name, Plan, Expiry Date pill.
screens.member_details: Profile header. Sections: Personal, Membership (current plan), Payment History, WhatsApp Logs.
screens.plans: List of plans as flat cards showing Name, Duration, Price, and active subscriber count.
screens.reminders: Log of WhatsApp messages sent. Status pills: Green (Delivered), Yellow (Sent), Red (Failed).
screens.settings: List UI with chevrons. Sections: Gym Profile, WhatsApp Config, Reminder Templates.

onboarding_bg.description: Modern gym interior to be used with a heavy white or black overlay for the onboarding success screen.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, nav items, inputs, list items) MUST have a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case, role-based. e.g., 'bottom-nav-dashboard', 'metric-card-revenue', 'add-member-button'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Treat this as a mobile web app UI built with React/Tailwind. Use a wrapper div like 'w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen relative' to simulate mobile view on desktop.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for layouts and avoid Shadcn structural components like Card if they restrict mobile spacing. Use Shadcn for complex logic (Dialogs, Select, Forms).
Replace generic Dialogs with bottom-anchored sheets for the mobile feel.
Ensure all text meets WCAG AA contrast against its background.
For charts, use recharts with a minimal setup: no axis lines, minimal grid, pure data focus.
Include <link href='https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=cabinet-grotesk@500,700,900&f[]=satoshi@400,500,700&display=swap' rel='stylesheet'> in index.html to load fonts.
